findings.status: static code established; official feature confirmed
findings.detail: Optional history sync pushes explicit record fields including refined_text and mode_meta plus identity/status/timestamps/duration/platform/version/concurrency metadata. mode_meta may carry selected_text and Ask AI results. Audio bytes, local path, audio_context and microphone data are absent from this push shape. Do not generalize that absence to all network processing.

findings.status: static cloud backing established; cross-device reuse inferred
findings.detail: Manual and auto-added dictionary terms are fetched/mutated through authenticated account API; bulk CSV import submits word content. The user guide describes auto/manual entries but does not independently promise synchronization latency.

findings.status: static remote persistence APIs established; exact cross-device refresh unknown
findings.detail: Cloud API stores personal_auto_style_on, user_info.locale, translation_settings.target_languages and dictation_settings.output_language_map; history enabled/retention_seconds are separate remote controls. This does not establish every setting syncs.

findings.status: static upload established; retained learned pattern vendor statement
findings.detail: Edits submit encrypted user_traits log containing inserted output, original/edited input-box content, active app, device environment, and mode; server may return auto_added_dictionary term and ID. Vendor says only abstract style patterns learned/stored, not specific content; actual server retention and cross-device pattern use unverified.

findings.status: static local storage established; focused negative search only
findings.detail: Shortcuts, microphone selection, startup, dock/flow-bar visibility, sounds, appearance and local historyDurationSeconds are in local app-settings store. No general account upload for them found in focused pass; not proof of absence. Remote cloud retention_seconds is separate.

findings.status: static policy flow established; server deletion vendor statement
findings.detail: enabled initial state is null; refresh retrieves remote status, no default established. Disable requests enabled:false; official says cloud text deleted. Individual synced deletion pushes tombstones while enabled, pull applies tombstones including local audio deletion. Wipe calls /transcription_history/wipe. Server erasure not observed.

official_sources.supports: Optional history cloud sync text, disable deletes cloud text; audio not retained; anonymous word statistics; cloud transcription; context processing and feedback exceptions.
Cloud audio/context real-time processing and deletion; optional history text retention; account/billing retention; diagnostic feedback exceptions.
Style learning claims abstract patterns retained, no specific messages; toggle to stop learning.
Dictionary manual/auto entries, correction auto-add, CSV import; history guide says only on device, conflicts with current data-controls and installed sync code.

unknowns: Actual requests or server retention/deletion/encryption enforcement were not observed.
No cross-device two-account/device experiment; dictionary/preferences synchronization is inferred from cloud-backed account APIs.
Default history enabled state not proven; client initialized null and depends on server.
Learned style schema, weights, storage format, retention and multi-device sharing remain unverified.
No broad guarantee all local preferences remain device-only; focused pass found explicit local storage.

chatterfly.scope: Chatterfly 1.0.6.13398 macOS shipped package only; no target execution, private databases, account state or traffic accessed

derivedArm64.method: system lipo -thin arm64; byte equality to original slice independently checked

findings.conclusion: Shipped product supports local/cloud user typing dictionary sync, manually and automatically. Preference copy says every four hours. Chatterfly-specific task enters only userDict sync, with download/unzip -> merge local -> upload zip path. Exact dictionary fields and other-device OS interoperability are not fully decoded.

findings.confidence: high for account service-backed CRUD; medium for actual cross-device consistency
findings.conclusion: Personal vocabulary term UI lists/creates/updates/deletes account-authenticated terms through EW POST transport. Create JSON contains text; update contains term_id,text; delete contains term_ids; list uses page,page_size. Logical alias ybime.lexicon_term.http.local is not established as a public routable host or OS localhost. No cross-device trial was run.

Inherited SGTaskSyncSetting zip/upload/download code exists, containing UserPreferences, skinInfo, scdInfo, FontStyle, symbolSubsitute, autoEngUserSet, hideInlineUserSet, cnUseEnSymAppsSet plist names. Do not report these as Chatterfly synced settings. syncAllUsrData chooses Sogou full-data task only for SogouInput; Chatterfly task directly starts userDict. Direct B/BL scan found no incoming call to syncYuanbao_downloadSetting; indirect dispatch not excluded.

findings.confidence: high for local store; cloud sync unestablished
findings.conclusion: Speech history UI calls it local and manager queries its store. Packaged SQL schema stores ASR/LLM configs/results and audio relative paths. No cross-device speech-history/audio sync path was established within inspected dictionary task and history manager; this does not prove absence throughout product.

ASR text and enhanced-recognition context (app/title, cursor text, clipboard, recent per-app input) enter network-capable speech/AI processing; those uploads are inference requests, not proof of account cloud synchronization. Shipped disclosure says high-frequency historic entities used temporarily for current transcription, discarded without cloud retention or model training. This is vendor copy, not measured retention.

findings.confidence: high for local build call; cloud route incomplete
findings.conclusion: YBVoiceDictSyncManager timer calls SGCoreService buildVoiceUsrDictWithCompletion then native pc_build_voice_usr. Its Sync name alone must not be treated as proof of extra cloud sync categories.

chatterfly.officialFetch: Web tool could not retrieve policy content; direct HTTP retrieved JS shell only. Policy text not used for behavioral conclusions. URLs established by packaged bytes. Unrelated chatterfly.in and chatterfly.org excluded.

Super transfer advertises cross-device copy/paste; this is distinct from the mobile local clipboard-history policy.

limitations: No two-device convergence or conflict experiment.

doubao.scope: Installed macOS DoubaoIme 1.0.2 build 1, Wave 1.0.2.7. Static package files only. No private stores or execution.
doubao.method: LLVM Mach-O disassembly, Swift string static array decode, relative byte jump table. All selected instruction bytes verified against source slice. Ordinary local observations, not REA evidence IDs.
limits: No network/runtime confirmation; default toggles unknown.
Entire shared enum lists mobile settings; only five Mac mapper registrations recovered.
Personal dictionary contents, common phrases, corrections-pair inclusion remain unspecified.
Ghidra search timed out at 240000ms; second pending search was stopped and close_binary succeeded.

findings.personalDictionary: Vendor policy confirms account-based multi-device sync; installed coordinator/owner and preference support. Contents unspecified.
findings.settings: Five Mac mapper registrations; remote shared enum is larger and not all registered.
findings.fuzzySoundsAndRecentPunctuation: Compiled handlers and native key-return code; runtime/active registration not independently exercised.
findings.clipboard: Separate cross-device plain/rich text and image transfer path; public feature corroboration; retention unresolved.
findings.history: No verified sync of input-history records/audio; inputHistoryUsable is only a context-use permission in mapped settings.
findings.telemetryAndInference: Separate processing/upload categories, not evidence of account sync.

doubao.stringDecode: Swift large UTF-8 literal address = (highWord & 0x0fffffffffffffff) + 32; length from lowWord. Small userDictUsable decoded inline.
